    Equivalence of E-finiteness with presilting generation of two-term thick subcategories #

    Assembles isEFinite_iff_twoTermThickGeneration (Theorem 7.8, (E-fin) ⇔ (thick-gen)). For the converse (thick-gen) ⇒ (E-fin), generating the thick subcategory of a single differential P by a presilting complex U identifies the modules inverting P with those inverting U (exists_presilting_same_inversions), forcing the singleton universal localization at P to be finite-dimensional and ruling out missing integral weights.
